title: Nominal Stabilization
dek: How prices, exchange rates, monetary conditions, and expectations interact during Argentina's stabilization process.

questions.title: Are inflation expectations leading, lagging, or validating realized inflation?
Are interest rates restrictive in real terms?
Has the disinflation process stalled or resumed?
How are BCRA FX purchases interacting with the exchange rate and monetary conditions?
How fast is inflation running now, and is it accelerating or decelerating?
How large is the gap between official and parallel exchange rates?
How much do exchange-rate movements pass through to domestic prices?
How much has the peso appreciated or depreciated in real terms?
How tight are bank reserve requirements and liquidity conditions?
Is disinflation broad-based across underlying inflation measures?
Is monetary-base growth consistent with the monetary-targeting framework?
Is remonetization proceeding fast enough to absorb monetary expansion without reigniting inflation?
Is stabilization credibility visible simultaneously in expectations, FX gaps, rates, and hedging demand?
What inflation path does the market expect over the next months and year-end?
Where is the official exchange rate inside the policy band?
